variables.input:
timeseries n = count(zeebe.health),
  by: {k8s.pod.name},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace))}
| fields k8s.pod.name
| sort k8s.pod.name asc

timeseries n = count(atomix.role),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace))}
| fields partition
| sort partition asc

1.content:
# Camunda 8.7 — Zeebe Overview

Ported from the Camunda Grafana dashboard `8.7.35-zeebe.json`. Metrics are expected in Grail as **Micrometer meter names** (`zeebe.stream.processor.records.total`), pushed straight from Camunda over OTLP with `delta` temporality — see `runbook-dynatrace.md`.

**Companion dashboards:** `8.7-zeebe-02-processing.json` · `8.7-zeebe-03-storage.json` · `8.7-zeebe-04-cluster.json` · `8.7-zeebe-05-resources.json`

2.content:
## General Overview
Cluster-wide health, throughput and resource headline signals.

3.title: Topology
3.description: Displays the roles of each node per partition.

4.title: Health
4.query:
timeseries health = min(zeebe.health),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayLast(health)
| fields partition, value

5.title: Pod Restarts
5.description:
Shows when and how often a pod was restarted.  The graph is zero when the pod is ready. With this it is also possible to determine how long it take for the pod to come ready again.

Ported from Grafana: Grafana derived restarts from `1 - kube_pod_container_status_ready`; this uses the Dynatrace built-in container restart counter instead, so the tile shows restart events per interval rather than a readiness flag (requires Dynatrace Kubernetes monitoring).

6.title: Banned instances
6.query:
timeseries banned_instances = max(zeebe.banned.instances.total),
  by: {k8s.namespace.name, partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayLast(banned_instances)
| fields k8s.namespace.name, partition, value
6.description: Shows the count of banned process instances of the namespace.

7.title: Processing per Partition
7.query:
timeseries {
    processed = sum(zeebe.stream.processor.records.total, rate:1s, filter:{in(action, "skipped", "processed")}),
    written = sum(zeebe.stream.processor.records.total, rate:1s, filter:{in(action, "written")})
  },
  by: {k8s.pod.name, partition, processor},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true

8.title: Exporting per Partition

9.title: Requests handled by Gateway per sec
9.description:
Requests which hit the gateway and a response have been sent to the client per second.

Ported from Grafana: Grafana joined the dead `grpc_server_handled_total` with the gRPC histogram's `_count` via `label_replace`. Dynatrace cannot read a histogram's observation count, so this uses the `zeebe.gateway.total.requests` counter split by requestType.

10.title: Overall FNI  per s
10.query:
timeseries instance_events_per_sec = sum(zeebe.element.instance.events.total, rate:1s, filter:{type != "PROCESS" and action != "activated"}),
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayAvg(instance_events_per_sec)
| summarize value = avg(value)
10.description: Flow node instances completed or terminated per second over all partitions.

11.title: Current Events

12.title: Completed Tasks in avg overtime per sec
12.query:
timeseries instance_events_per_sec = sum(zeebe.element.instance.events.total, rate:1s, filter:{action == "completed" and type == "SERVICE_TASK"}),
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayAvg(instance_events_per_sec)
| summarize value = avg(value)

thresholds.title: Completed Tasks in avg overtime per sec

12.description: Takes the avg of all completed tasks per second over the given time range.

13.title: Completed Processes in avg overtime per sec
13.query:
timeseries instance_events_per_sec = sum(zeebe.element.instance.events.total, rate:1s, filter:{action == "completed" and type == "PROCESS"}),
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd value = arrayAvg(instance_events_per_sec)
| summarize value = avg(value)

thresholds.title: Completed Processes in avg overtime per sec

13.description: Takes the avg of all completed processes per second over the given time range.

14.title: PVC Disk Usage
14.query:
timeseries {
    persistentvolumeclaim_used_a = avg(dt.kubernetes.persistentvolumeclaim.used, default:0, filter:{matchesValue(k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name, "*zeebe*")}),
    persistentvolumeclaim_capacity_b = avg(dt.kubernetes.persistentvolumeclaim.capacity, filter:{matchesValue(k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name, "*zeebe*")})
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace))},
  union: true,
  nonempty: true
| fieldsAdd ratio = persistentvolumeclaim_used_a[] / persistentvolumeclaim_capacity_b[]
| fieldsRemove persistentvolumeclaim_used_a, persistentvolumeclaim_capacity_b

15.title: Backpressure Dropping Requests
15.query:
timeseries {
    request_count_a = sum(zeebe.dropped.request.count.total, rate:1s, default:0),
    request_count_b = sum(zeebe.received.request.count.total, rate:1s)
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true,
  nonempty: true
| fieldsAdd ratio = 100 * request_count_a[] / request_count_b[]
| fieldsRemove request_count_a, request_count_b

16.title: Cluster Load
16.query:
timeseries load = avg(zeebe.flow.control.partition.load),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| filter arrayMax(load) > 0
| fieldsAdd partition_load = arrayAvg(load)
| summarize cluster_load = avg(partition_load)
16.description:
The current cluster load is defined by the current write rate divided by the write rate limit. The cluster load will display no data unless the flow control rate write limits are enabled.

Ported from Grafana: `avg(load > 0)`: the `> 0` filter excludes partitions with no measured load, so partitions are filtered before averaging. Shows no data when flow-control write rate limits are disabled, exactly like the original.

17.title: Process memory usage
17.query:
timeseries {
    rss = avg(dt.kubernetes.container.memory_working_set, filter:{matchesValue(k8s.container.name, "zeebe*")}),
    limit_v = max(dt.kubernetes.container.limits_memory, filter:{matchesValue(k8s.container.name, "zeebe*")}),
    request = min(dt.kubernetes.container.requests_memory, filter:{matchesValue(k8s.container.name, "zeebe*")})
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
17.description: Memory limits and requests are taken from the k8 pod metrics.

18.content:
## Start up
Broker and partition start-up / recovery timings.

19.title: Atomix Partition Server Startup time
19.description:
Time taken to start and bootstrap partition servers.

Dropped query: atomix_partition_server_startup_time: only atomix.partition.server.bootstrap.time / .join.time exist in 8.7

20.title: Streamprocessor Recovery Time
20.description: Time taken to recover and reprocess events

21.title: Leader transition duration
21.description: The time needed to install all leader services on a newly elected leader until it is ready to process new requests.

22.content:
## Cluster
Dynamic scaling and topology change operations.

23.title: Topology Change Operations
23.description: Number of completed and pending operations

24.title: Number of Failed Operations
24.query:
timeseries operation_attempts = sum(zeebe.cluster.changes.operation.attempts, filter:{outcome == "failed"}),
  by: {k8s.pod.name, operation},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd operation_attempts = arrayCumulativeSum(operation_attempts)
24.description: Counters arrive from Camunda as OTLP **delta** values (Dynatrace does not ingest cumulative counters), so each column is cumulated over the selected timeframe to reproduce Grafana's monotonic counter view.

25.title: Operation Duration
25.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.cluster.changes.operation.duration, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.cluster.changes.operation.duration, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.cluster.changes.operation.duration, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
25.description:
The time it takes to apply each operation

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

26.title: Number of Applied Operations
26.query:
timeseries operation_attempts = sum(zeebe.cluster.changes.operation.attempts, filter:{outcome == "applied"}),
  by: {k8s.pod.name, operation},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))}
| fieldsAdd operation_attempts = arrayCumulativeSum(operation_attempts)
26.description: Counters arrive from Camunda as OTLP **delta** values (Dynatrace does not ingest cumulative counters), so each column is cumulated over the selected timeframe to reproduce Grafana's monotonic counter view.
